input: The project content target and a clip id.
output: How many audio channels the stored original of the clip has (every channel of every audio stream, as the player counts them); none when the record has no channel counts. Read-only, no probe, no guessed count.
specification: User rule 2026-09-30: the channel heard on A1 is chosen only from the real channels of the clip (a channel the clip lacks would be refused by the player).
